attributes.action: Remove George Akhtar from ownership of Kettering Town Football CLub
attributes.additional_details: By signing this petition, you're showing clear discontent with the ownership of Kettering Town Football Club and would like the immediate removal of current owner George Akhtar.
attributes.background: Owing to recent events whereby long standing club volunteers have left the club, unprofessional sponsorships and consistently concerning poor ownership with no clarity to fans as to the decisions being made.
